mapper.select: SELECT id, name, description, category, visibility, owner_id AS "ownerId", dept_id AS "deptId", chunk_size AS "chunkSize", chunk_overlap AS "chunkOverlap", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kb_document d WHERE d.kb_id = kb_knowledge_base.id AND d.deleted = FALSE) AS "docCount", created_at AS "createdAt", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM kb_knowledge_base WHERE deleted = FALSE ORDER BY id DESC

SELECT id, name, description, category, visibility, owner_id AS "ownerId", dept_id AS "deptId", chunk_size AS "chunkSize", chunk_overlap AS "chunkOverlap", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kb_document d WHERE d.kb_id = kb_knowledge_base.id AND d.deleted = FALSE) AS "docCount", created_at AS "createdAt", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM kb_knowledge_base WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kb_knowledge_base(name, description, category, visibility, owner_id, dept_id, chunk_size, chunk_overlap, embedding_model, status) VALUES(#{name}, #{description}, #{category}, #{visibility}, #{ownerId}, #{deptId}, #{chunkSize}, #{chunkOverlap}, COALESCE(#{embeddingModel}, 'bge-m3'), COALESCE(#{status}, 1))
mapper.update: UPDATE kb_knowledge_base SET name = COALESCE(#{name}, name), description = COALESCE(#{description}, description), visibility = #{visibility}, dept_id = #{deptId}, chunk_size = COALESCE(#{chunkSize}, chunk_size), chunk_overlap = COALESCE(#{chunkOverlap}, chunk_overlap), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE kb_knowledge_base SET deleted = TRUE, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
